tags.name: fem-now-playing
tags.description: The big view: artwork, title, seek bar, and controls. With a track set it shows that track, ready to play, as on a share page. Without one it follows whatever is playing.

tags.name: fem-play-button
tags.description: Plays a track, or a whole list from its first track, and turns to pause while that track plays. Use it for "Play" on a profile or playlist header.

tags.name: fem-player-bar
tags.description: The mini player that sits along the bottom of an app. Wide, it shows transport, seek, and volume. Narrow, it folds to the track and a play button, with a thin progress line. Tap the track to send expand. With dismissible, a swipe down stops playback and sends dismiss.

tags.name: fem-track-row
tags.description: One track in a list. Tap it to play the list from here. The playing track shows its state, and the trailing slot holds actions like a menu.
